versions.changelog:
psych312-scenario-analysis 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Provides scenario-based psychological analysis strictly aligned with the official “312 Psychology” exam syllabus.
- Automatically identifies relevant exam knowledge points from user-submitted real-life scenarios, stories, or case fragments.
- Outputs analyses in a fixed three-part structure: knowledge term, double explanation (standard definition + plain language), and scene-based causation.
- Covers established topics from General, Social, Developmental, Educational Psychology, and core Personality/Clinical basics.
- Ensures output can be directly used for exam-oriented answers, case analyses, and knowledge reviews, free from out-of-syllabus content.
